authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/dexibell/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/dexibell/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a block of the document's Received data, sent as its controller: the tonewheel organ's on the variable organChannel (its default, 14, as each block says), the others on the channel variable. Each is received only when its RX setting is on, as its block's note says. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Every drawbar's list of levels (26) prints 60H as "7", as it does 70H, and has no level 6: 60H is read as 6, the level its place in the order shows (an inference, written down).
Laid out as the byte range printed, the numbers beside it being of another width: TW Upper Preset (00H~17H beside 1~23); TW Lower Preset (00H~17H beside 1~23); TW Pedal Preset (00H~05H beside 1~5).

Left out, the performance controllers, bank select and messages that are not settings: Bank Sound Select (CC 0, 32), Modulation (CC 1), Expression (CC 11), Hold (CC 64), Sostenuto (CC 66), Soft (CC 67), All Sounds Off (CC 120), Reset All Controllers (CC 121), All Notes Off (CC 123).
